disputeMessage.title: Saƙo daga Gwani game da ƙorafinka

disputeEvidence.title: Gwani tana buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da ƙorafinka
disputeEvidence.body: {{text}} Da fatan ka amsa cikin awa {{hours}}.

disputeDecisionRefund.title: Hukuncin ƙorafi: {{outcome}}
disputeDecisionRefund.body: {{reason}} Za a mayar wa abokin ciniki {{amount}}.

reviewRemoved.title: An cire wani ra’ayi daga shafinka
reviewRemoved.body: Ya saɓa wa ƙa’idojin ra’ayi na Gwani ({{reason}}). An sake lissafa ƙimarka.

contentRemoved.title: An cire {{kind}} naka
contentRemoved.body: Dalili: {{reason}}. Za ka iya ɗaukaka ƙara daga “Tabbatarwa da matsayi” a dashboard ɗinka.

warning.title: Gargaɗi daga Gwani
warning.body: {{reason}}. Maimaita saɓa wa ƙa’ida zai iya kai ga dakatarwa.

suspended.title: An dakatar da asusunka
suspended.body: {{reason}}. Abokan ciniki suna ganin shafinka, amma ba za su iya aika sababbin buƙatu ko oda ba. Ayyukanka, ododinka da kuɗin shigarka na yanzu suna nan lafiya.

appealDeclined.title: Ba a karɓi ɗaukaka ƙararka ba

slaReminder.title: Abokan ciniki suna jiran amsoshinka
slaReminder.body: Wasu buƙatun kwanan nan sun jira amsa fiye da yadda ya kamata. Amsawa da sauri (ko don ƙi ma) yana faranta wa abokan ciniki rai kuma yana taimaka maka ka bayyana sama a bincike.

reengage.title: Muna son taimaka maka ka sami ƙarin aiki
reengage.body: Abokan ciniki a yankinka suna neman masu sana’a kamarka. Ci gaba da biyan kuɗin wata-wata, sabunta hotunanka da lokutan aikinka, kuma ka amsa mana idan wani abu yana hana ka.

verified.title: Kai yanzu {{tier}} ne
verified.body: An amince da takardunka. Shafinka yanzu yana nuna alamar {{tier}}.

verificationRejected.title: Ba a amince da tantancewa ba
verificationRejected.body: Dalili: {{reason}}. Za ka iya ɗora sababbin takardu daga “Tantancewa” a dashboard ɗinka.

verificationMoreInfo.title: Ana buƙatar ƙarin takardu don tantancewa

welcomeClaimed.title: Barka da zuwa Gwani
welcomeClaimed.body: Shafinka yana aiki. Ƙara hotuna, ayyukanka da farashinsu don abokan ciniki su iya neman ka. An saita membobinka ta {{association}}.

passwordChanged.title: An canza kalmar sirrinka
passwordChanged.body: An canza kalmar sirrinka. Idan ba kai ba ne, tuntuɓi tallafi: {{support}}.

newDevice.title: Sabon shiga a asusunka
newDevice.body: An shiga asusunka yanzu a kan {{device}} kusa da {{location}}. Idan ba kai ba ne, fitar da wannan na’ura kuma ka canza kalmar sirrinka.
